389:t_2:29.en:
$$レド$$
「After the Lieutenant Colonel's death, that plan was taken over by $$ストライカー#robot$$, the $$マシンキャリバー$$ he piloted.」

389:t_2:30.en:
$$タケル$$
「So, like $$チェインバー#pilot$$, a pilot support and enlightenment interface?」

389:t_2:31.en:
$$レド$$
「It called itself the Human Support and Enlightenment Regulation System... a being known as a god.」

389:t_2:32.en:
$$タケル$$
「A machine called itself a god...」

389:t_2:34.en:
$$レド$$
「So I fought it together with $$チェインバー#pilot$$. Of my own will.」

389:t_2:35.en:
$$アルト$$
「The $$ギャラクシー船団$$ intervened in that fight with $$ストライカー#robot$$.」

389:t_2:36.en:
$$甲児$$
「So they were alive after all...」

389:t_2:37.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「They got beaten black and blue in the $$再世戦争$$ and they still haven't learned.」

389:t_2:38.en:
$$アルト$$
「But it seems they've developed a way to control the $$バジュラ$$.」

389:t_2:40.en:
$$アルト$$
「The differently colored $$バジュラ$$ we fought at the center of the galaxy were being controlled by the $$ギャラクシー船団$$.」

389:t_2:41.en:
$$アルト$$
「They put $$ブレラ$$ under their control again and attacked us.」

389:t_2:42.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「So what happened to $$ブレラ$$?」

389:t_2:43.en:
$$アルト$$
「No need to worry. The receiver system in his body was destroyed, so they'll never be able to control him again.」

389:t_2:44.en:
$$レド$$
「And then $$ストライカー#robot$$ joined up with a force that seemed to be that $$ギャラクシー船団$$ and left.」

389:t_2:45.en:
$$宗介$$
「So the fight with that thing is still going to continue.」

389:t_2:47.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Somehow, $$レド$$... you seem different from before.」

389:t_2:48.en:
$$勝平$$
「Is that the whole 'stop being the quiet type' thing?」

389:t_2:49.en:
$$レド$$
「...Until now, somewhere in my heart, I seem to have been held captive by my identity as a soldier of the $$人類銀河同盟$$.」

389:t_2:50.en:
$$レド$$
「My attacks on the $$ヒディアーズ#keyword$$... and on the $$クジライカ$$ were probably a result of that too.」

389:t_2:51.en:
$$宗介$$
「So you've broken free of that.」

389:t_2:52.en:
$$レド$$
「Lieutenant Colonel $$クーゲル$$... In the fight with $$ストライカー#robot$$, I was able to learn what I fight for and what I want to protect.」

389:t_2:53.en:
$$レド$$
「I may be a failure as a soldier. But I want to live as a human being.」

389:t_2:54.en:
$$アルト$$
「It seems $$チェインバー#pilot$$ will lend its strength to a $$レド$$ like that, too.」

389:t_2:55.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「It got powered up too, with the gear made from the treasure that yours truly repaired.」

389:t_2:56.en:
$$アルト$$
「By the way, $$ラケージ$$, that female pirate of the $$残されの海$$, has decided to come along with us too.」

389:t_2:57.en:
$$甲児$$
「The woman who was riding that lobster-type $$ユンボロ$$?」

389:t_2:58.en:
$$レド$$
「I hear she took a liking to $$ピニオン$$.」

389:t_2:59.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「D-Don't say unnecessary things, $$レド$$!」

389:t_2:61.en:
$$勝平$$
「I don't really get the human stuff, but Big Bro $$レド$$ looks a lot more alive and happier now.」

389:t_2:62.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Could this be the power of $$エイミー$$'s love, too?」

389:t_2:63.en:
$$レド$$
「I don't understand love very well, but I want to live together with $$エイミー$$.」

389:t_2:66.en:
$$タケル$$
「You still have a lot you need to learn.」

389:t_2:67.en:
$$宗介$$
「But I welcome you once more, $$レド$$. You are a member of $c.」

389:t_2:69.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Still, I was surprised. I never thought $$ランド$$ had worries or anxieties.」

389:t_2:70.en:
$$ランド$$
「Adults don't show that kind of thing on the outside.」

389:t_2:71.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Maybe so. $$ジャミル$$ was the same.」

389:t_2:72.en:
$$クロウ$$
「But when adults in the same boat get together, it turns into a gripe fest right away.」

389:t_2:73.en:
$$ランド$$
「Well... guess we need to blow off steam.」

389:t_2:74.en:
$$メール$$
「What are you saying, Darling! All that steam you blow off guzzling beer is why our business is in the red every single time!」

389:t_2:75.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Don't be so angry, $$メール$$. If you keep talking about money, you'll make $$ランド$$ feel bad.」

389:t_2:77.en:
$n
「For $$ランド$$'s smile, you've got to put up with a little spending.」

389:t_2:78.en:
$$メール$$
「No fair! You're trying to sweet-talk me four against one!」

389:t_2:79.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「A lovely show of mutual aid between Reactors.」

389:t_2:80.en:
$$ドロシー#bigo$$
「So everyone's on the same level.」

389:t_2:82.en:
$$クロウ$$
「No need to thank us. You showed us how to get over the wall.」

389:t_2:84.en:
$$セツコ$$
「Yes... The nameless anxiety that you and $n feel is inside me as well.」

389:t_2:85.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Looks like that's why the last door on our machines won't open.」

389:t_2:87.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Not only do we have to dread the backlash, but this comes along with it? That's excess service, $$スフィア$$...」

389:t_2:91.en:
$n
「I was thinking I'd follow $$ランド$$'s example and try hard too.」

389:t_2:92.en:
$$ランド$$
「That's the spirit, kid! You walk the road to being a grown man too!」

389:t_2:94.en:
$n
(If the anxiety is a phenomenon unique to Reactors, then what was Miss $$スズネ$$ so afraid of...)

389:t_2:95.en:
$n
(Does it have something to do with how she stopped feeling anxious right before she was taken...)

389:t_10:3.en:
$$クロウ$$
「...What the heck is that $$エルーナルーナ$$ thing...」

389:t_10:4.en:
$$セツコ$$
「I never could have imagined it back when she was wrapped in armor.」

389:t_10:5.en:
$n
「No matter how great her command ability is, I can see why people would judge that 'with that at the head of the military...'」

389:t_10:6.en:
$$クロウ$$
「I sympathized a little with $$皇帝アウストラリス$$ just now.」

389:t_10:7.en:
$n
「I feel for $$ランド$$, who's going to have her hounding him.」

389:t_10:8.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「...Well, everyone... you all seem to have mixed feelings about $$エルーナルーナ$$'s appearance, but it moved every one of your hearts greatly.」

389:t_10:9.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「The $$Ｚチップ$$ produced by that come to 100 Z! I'll add them to the unit's stock.」

389:t_10:12.en:
$$セツコ$$
「AG, if you take off your armor, is there... inside you too? That's not the case, is it?」

389:t_10:13.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「How lewd~. So that's what you're thinking, peeling off my armor?」

389:t_10:15.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I'm sorry to disappoint you, but I'm only a robot after all...」
